messages:
maria: Heads-up — per-route token-level dashboard spiking since ~03:00 UTC. p99 cross-region latency up, and failover_count for eu-west -> us-west jumped 3x. I think kernel-selection fallbacks are involved. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/latency/per-route

ben: Can you paste the panel queries? I can already see p95 jump on the eu-west routes.

maria: Panel query (prom):
```
sum by(route)(rate(runtime_token_latency_bucket{le!="+Inf",region="eu-west"}[5m]))
```
and failovers: `increase(routing_failover_total{from_region="eu-west",to_region="us-west"}[5m])`

ashley: We rolled a batching heuristic tweak in canary yesterday — it biases larger batch windows under high concurrency to hit throughput targets. That can increase inter-request batch diversity and raise KV cache miss rates for warm requests.

ram: We need a token-level breakdown: decode_time vs kv_lookup vs kernel_exec vs network. Current dashboards aggregate too much.

maria: Agreed. Quick profiling snapshot from a failed trace (shortened):
```
trace_id=01A..  total=420ms
  token_decode=12ms
  kv_cache_lookup=76ms  (misses increased)
  kernel_selection=38ms  (fallback to generic kernel)
  kernel_exec=270ms
  network=24ms
```
Kernel selection time is spiking when the runtime decides the optimized kernel isn't compatible (sequence len / quantization mismatch) and falls back to generic path.

deploy-bot: deploy rollback? @ashley requested rollback for canary batching tweak — build 2026.03.14-amber -> queued.

ashley: Let's not rollback globally yet. Plan A: revert heuristic only on canary cluster and collect data. Plan B: add tagging so runtime emits `kernel_variant` and `kvcache_hit` per-request metrics.

ben: We should also add a per-route KPI: token_latency_components{route,component} so dashboards can show stacked bars (kv, kernel_selection, kernel_exec, decode, network). That will make it much easier to spot the failure mode.

ram: I'll add metrics and a lightweight histogram for each component: `runtime_token_component_seconds_bucket{component="kernel_exec"}` and add a derived per-token breakdown panel. Will also instrument kernel_variant as a label on the span.

product-ops: Any customer-facing impact? Seen any support tickets?

maria: A couple mid-market customers have flagged tail latency regressions. No P1s yet but CS flagged it.

ashley: Also notice cross-region routing: when kernel_variant fallback occurs on region A, router tries region B and sometimes that triggers another fallback there because the model variant differs. We should add a routing decision metric: `routing_decision_reason{route,from_region,to_region}` to count decisions caused by kernel-unavailable vs capacity-constraints.

ben: Good call. That lets us distinguish capacity-triggered failovers from compatibility-triggered failovers.

infra-bot: created ticket INF-1234: "Per-token component metrics + kernel_variant tagging + routing_decision_reason" assigned to eng-runtime.

ram: Timeline proposal: +1 day to add metrics + new Grafana panels, +2 days to run canary with revert and observe. If we see KV hit rate drop when batching tweak is on, we revert.

maria: Action items:
- ram: add token component histograms + kernel_variant label (INF-1234)
- ashley: revert batching heuristic on canary and monitor kvcache_hit_rate by route
- ben: add stacked per-route token breakdown panels and routing decision panel
- product-ops: notify CS to watch flagged customers and hold communications until we see canary results

maria: I'll follow up with a short postmortem if the canary shows regression persists. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

ben: ping me if you want help validating dashboard queries.

ashley: starting the canary revert now (ETA ~15m).

infra-bot: canary revert deployed to cluster-canary-3 at 1789504584.

maria: Noted — will watch the p99 panel and kvcache_hit_rate.

(ended)
